draft.text: I am pleased to introduce my new technical book, From Token to Fleet, which details the engineering challenges of scaling large language model inference across a single GPU to an entire cluster of accelerators. The work breaks down the system design decisions that enable efficient communication, memory management, and load balancing as the workload grows from one token generation to thousands of concurrent requests. Readers will find concrete architecture patterns and performance benchmarks that can guide teams building production‑grade LLM services.
